# Maudite Machine

> Maudite Machine is a DJ and producer based between Canada, France and Spain, after fifteen years in the Montréal underground. He plays indie dance and psy prog, as a DJ (CDJ) and as a hybrid live act (synths and grooveboxes). He founded VRSTL Records, an independent label with 21 EPs and 2 albums, and is a member of the 8day collective in Montréal. Available for club and festival dates across France, Spain and the rest of Europe, and still playing Canada.

The website is an interactive drum machine (MM-RYTM), arpeggiator synthesizer (MM-ARP) and pair of DJ decks with a mixer (MM-DECKS) in 3D; every section also has a plain HTML page.

## Facts

- Genre: indie dance and psy prog
- Formats: DJ set (90 minutes to 4 hours) and hybrid live (60 to 75 minutes)
- Label: VRSTL Records (founder and A&R)
- Latest album: Limbos, VRSTL Records, October 2025 (9 tracks)
- Latest single: Voodoo, VRSTL Records, February 2026
- Played: Techno Parade Paris, OKAMI Festival, Piknic Électronik, SAT, Igloofest afters, Groove and Bass
- Shared bills: Carl Craig, Popof, Christian Smith, Perc, Agoria, Nick Curly, Damon Jee

## Booking

- Canada and USA: mauditemachine@gmail.com
